issue.title: test_notify_rules help test hard-codes Python 3.13 argparse spelling '-e, --explain ID'; fails on 3.12
issue.description:
`tests/main/test_notify_rules.py::test_help_documents_the_options` fails deterministically on Python 3.12.3 (this workspace's `.venv`), in isolation and in the scoped lane, at master 4255afbb05 (added by 03cc36be5c `feat(notify): add sase notify rules ...`).

Root cause: line 518 asserts the literal substring `-e, --explain ID`. argparse changed how it renders an option with a metavar in Python 3.13 (`-e, --explain ID`); Python 3.12 renders `-e ID, --explain ID`, which is what `sase notify rules -h` prints here:

```
  -e ID, --explain ID  Explain one stored notification ...
  -j, --json           Emit machine-readable JSON ...
```

Fix: make the assertion independent of the argparse version (for example assert `--explain` and `ID` appear, or accept either spelling), and keep the ordering check `out.index("--explain") < out.index("--json")`. Check the project's supported Python range so CI on 3.12 does not hit this either.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: fails on every run, in isolation and in the scoped lane, on Python 3.12.3. The assertion hard-codes the Python 3.13 argparse help spelling; 3.12 prints "-e ID, --explain ID".

evidence.note: Independent reproduction while landing epic sase-14l (proposed by phase bead sase-14l.3, note #1). At master 383f2c282 in workspace sase_16, tests/main/test_notify_rules.py::test_help_documents_the_options fails both inside the full just check lane and in an isolated serial rerun (.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:randomly). Python 3.12 argparse renders 'usage: sase notify rules [-h] [-e ID] [-j]' and the option line without the '-e, --explain ID' spelling the assertion hard-codes. Deterministic, not load-related.

Independently reproduced on clean origin/master e1ba4851c under the workspace venv (Python 3.12): tests/main/test_notify_rules.py::test_help_documents_the_options fails deterministically, in isolation and in the scoped check lane.
Found by sase-16h.land: Master Gate run 35793653133 (b5e112a2b, Python 3.12) fails tests/main/test_notify_rules.py::test_help_documents_the_options - help shows '-e ID' not '-e, --explain ID'.

Independent reproduction while landing epic sase-169 (proposed by phase bead sase-169.5, note #4). At master 4be75a3d4 in workspace sase_16 on Python 3.12.3, an isolated run of tests/main/test_notify_rules.py::test_help_documents_the_options still fails: the help output has no '-e, --explain ID' substring. Deterministic; unrelated to sase-169.
